rooms.name: Cryo-Dock Awakening
rooms.description: Primary stasis bay of Orbital Station Zenith. Restore auxiliary circuits and calibrate movement.

rooms.name: Jump Calibration Bay
rooms.description: Multi-tiered platforming calibration deck. Use jump thrusters to scale elevated structures.

rooms.name: Crate Logistics Lab
rooms.description: Logistics handling sector. Push heavy storage cubes to bypass pressure barriers.

rooms.name: Apex Vault I: Cryo Matrix
rooms.description: Sanctuary of the first Quantum Nexus Fragment. Guarded by an autonomous sentry drone.

rooms.name: Dual Relay Chamber
rooms.description: Coupled pressure switch room. Both circuit plates must be weighed down simultaneously.

rooms.name: Stacking Stepper Pit
rooms.description: Hazardous floor gap. Build a stepping staircase across the pit using industrial blocks.

rooms.name: Laser Synchronization Maze
rooms.description: Labyrinth of reactive laser emitters. Synchronize terminal toggles to secure the Red Keycard.

items.name: Red Keycard
items.description: Tier 2 Clearance for Reactor and Hangars.

rooms.name: Quantum Inversion Matrix
rooms.description: Teleportation test chamber housing Nexus Fragment II. Route particle beams across elevations.

rooms.name: Freight Receiving Dock
rooms.description: Primary cargo loading dock. Heavy freight containers and service lifts connect the bays.

rooms.name: Deep Cryo Warehouse
rooms.description: Sub-zero storage bays. Slick metallic decks allow rapid crate momentum sliding.

rooms.name: Hazardous Waste Sump
rooms.description: Sealed chemical disposal sector. Navigate narrow catwalks above toxic chemical pools.

rooms.name: High-Value Vault III: AI Sub-Brain
rooms.description: Reinforced high-security vault storing Nexus Fragment III. Encased behind blast locks.

rooms.name: Plasma Generator Hub
rooms.description: Primary plasma generation conduit. Pulsing reactors supply power across station bulkheads.

rooms.name: High Voltage Transformer
rooms.description: High voltage substation. Push insulating blocks to intercept cascading laser arcs.

rooms.name: Supercharger Sub-Station
rooms.description: Critical power relay storing the Green Keycard. Clearance permits passage to the Citadel.

items.name: Green Keycard
items.description: Tier 3 Master Clearance for Omega Sanctum.

rooms.name: Reactor Core Apex
rooms.description: Graviton Dynamo chamber harboring Nexus Fragment IV. Heavy radiation requires precision navigation.

rooms.name: Drone Sentinel Perimeter
rooms.description: Front line defense matrix. Heavy autonomous sentry bots patrol the corridors.

rooms.name: Interceptor Bastion
rooms.description: High alert interceptor redoubt. Guardian drones lock on and pursue intruders relentlessly.

rooms.name: Master Access Antechamber
rooms.description: Outer antechamber to the Overmind Core. Nexus Fragment V must be unified to unlock Sector 20.

items.name: Nexus Fragment V: Chrono Resonance
items.description: Fifth and final fragment. Harmonizes hyperspace matrix.

rooms.name: Overmind Sanctum Core
rooms.description: Central nexus of Station Zenith. Unify all 5 Nexus Fragments and 3 Energy Cells to trigger hyperspace warp.

rooms.name: Orbital Transit Grand Nexus
rooms.description: Grand central transit atrium connecting Wing B Cargo Facilities and Wing C Energy Reactor. Features dual moving transit elevators, perimeter mezzanine catwalks, and the central Fragment Receptacle.

items.name: Nexus High-Output Cell
items.description: Power cell stabilizing central transit grid.

rooms.name: Cargo Intake & Weigh Station
rooms.description: Automated freight receiving line. Heavy pallets must be positioned on calibrated pressure scales to disengage security laser fences.

rooms.name: Hydraulic Lift Shaft
rooms.description: Massive hydraulic freight elevator. Ride the vertical lift platform to reach the upper gantry crane controls.

rooms.name: Sub-Zero Stacking Bay
rooms.description: Cryogenic staging chamber. A sheer two-unit vertical bulkhead blocks the upper catwalk. Push crate from the raised ledge to stack atop the floor crate!

rooms.name: Container Crane Gantry
rooms.description: Suspended high catwalks spanning across automated container bays. Secret air vent in the southeast ledge leads down to the maintenance substructure.

rooms.name: Cryo-Storage Apex Vault
rooms.description: Deep stasis apex vault. Houses Nexus Fragment I: Cryo-Stasis Shard upon the central stepped dais guarded by dual containment lasers.

items.name: Nexus Fragment I: Cryo-Stasis Shard
items.description: First core shard of the Orbital Transit Overmind.

rooms.name: Sub-Deck Maintenance Vent (SECRET)
rooms.description: Concealed sub-deck utility crawlspace. Contains the rare Blue Cryo-Keycard and high-capacity cells discarded by station engineers.

items.name: Cryo-Engineering Blue Keycard
items.description: Grants level-1 clearance to locked station doors.

rooms.name: Cargo Chute Bypass (SHORTCUT)
rooms.description: High-level pneumatic express chute. Pull the interlock lever to permanently unlock a direct shortcut back into the Core Nexus Hub mezzanine!

rooms.name: Plasma Distribution Junction
rooms.description: High-voltage plasma conduit junction. Pulsating floor conduits and magnetic transformers route energy across Wing C.

rooms.name: High Voltage Stepping Conduits
rooms.description: Elevated capacitor towers rising above open zero-resistance conduit channels. Time jumps across stepping blocks over live laser barriers.

rooms.name: Laser Reflection Relay Chamber
rooms.description: Optical laser sensor chamber. Push insulated ceramic mirror crates into the horizontal laser path to block the beam and unlock the north bulkhead.

rooms.name: Electromagnetic Elevator Core
rooms.description: Twin alternating electromagnetic elevators ascending and descending in anti-phase. Leap between moving lifts to scale the north reactor gantry. Secret hatch under the south pit leads to the Capacitor Cache.

rooms.name: The Reactor Core Heart
rooms.description: The superheated core heart of Station Zenith. Push both coolant dampening blocks onto receptor plates to extinguish the plasma containment laser grid and secure Nexus Fragment II.

items.name: Nexus Fragment II: Fusion Core Torus
items.description: Second core shard of the Orbital Transit Overmind.

rooms.name: Overcharged Capacitor Cache (SECRET)
rooms.description: Sub-reactor thermal sanctuary. Hidden under the electromagnetic elevator shaft, this chamber stores the Red Authorization Keycard and high-capacity cells.

items.name: Reactor Authorization Red Keycard
items.description: Grants level-2 security clearance for reactor systems.

rooms.name: High-Energy Service Conduit (SHORTCUT)
rooms.description: Overhead reactor exhaust service gantry. Operating the manual bypass wheel permanently unlocks the blast bulkhead directly into the Core Nexus Hub East Balcony!

rooms.name: Cargo Stacking Testing Facility
rooms.description: Automated hydraulic proving ground. Stack freight crates atop one another to bypass the elevated optical tripwires and reach the high observation deck.

rooms.name: Dual-Mass Hydraulic Crucible
rooms.description: Deep stabilization chamber. Two separate heavy hydraulic pressure pads require calibrated dual-tier freight stacks to release the magnetic security seal.

rooms.name: High-Bay Vertical Stepper
rooms.description: Massive vertical shaft with tiered retaining walls. Build a 2-tier and 3-tier stepped cargo staircase to overcome the massive structural barricades.

rooms.name: Laser Interception Gantry
rooms.description: Dual-frequency optical grid corridor. Standard crates only block the ground beam; you must stack two crates to occlude both upper and lower laser arrays simultaneously!

rooms.name: Magnetic Freight Balancer
rooms.description: Precision magnetic balancing vault. Distribute calibrated weight stacks across 3 separate sensor nodes to disarm the central security field.

rooms.name: Cryo-Crate Logistics Sorter
rooms.description: Sub-zero automated sorting deck. Navigate refrigerated slipways and stack heavy cargo to bridge across frozen conduits.

rooms.name: Pneumatic Column Press
rooms.description: Massive hydraulic stamping pit. Stack three crates into a vertical column to trigger the high-overhead laser interlock sensor.

rooms.name: Overhead Concourse Mezzanine
rooms.description: Sprawling high-bay concourse with suspended gantry walkways. Build multi-tiered stepping formations to climb to the elevated catwalks.

rooms.name: Dual-Beam Deflection Vault
rooms.description: Synchronized laser containment grid. Use mobile crate stacks as physical ray-shields to occlude crossing beams while avoiding patrolling defense drones.

rooms.name: Apex Stacking Colosseum
rooms.description: Grand master proving arena. Solve the ultimate stacking trial: position multiple 2-tier and 3-tier columns to activate all quadrant nodes and unlock Archival Vault Zero.

collectibles.name: Grand Nexus Fragment Omega
collectibles.description: The grand prize of the Colosseum.

rooms.name: Sub-Vault Maintenance Nook (SECRET)
rooms.description: Uncataloged sub-deck crawlspace discovered by stacking freight containers up to the high ventilation shafts in Sector 37.

rooms.name: Cryo-Depot Hidden Catacomb (SECRET)
rooms.description: Ancient cryogenic reserve chamber hidden behind the upper ventilation grilles of Deep Cryo Warehouse Sector 10. Stacked crates allowed access.

rooms.name: Decommissioned Drone Foundry (SECRET)
rooms.description: Mothballed sentinel assembly facility. Bypassed via a crate-stacking bridge over the high security barricade in Sector 18.

rooms.name: Plasma Conductor Void (SECRET)
rooms.description: Unshielded energetic pocket reached by stacking crates as stepping platforms up the High Voltage Stepping Conduits of Sector 29.

rooms.name: Archival Vault Zero (SECRET)
rooms.description: The lost station data sanctum. Only accessible by building a 3-crate column to reach the highest observation grille in Sector 44.

collectibles.name: Zenith Master Crest
collectibles.description: Golden station crest proving complete exploration.

rooms.name: High-Catwalk Express (SHORTCUT)
rooms.description: High-level cargo conveyor catwalk unlocked by stacking crates to reach the overhead hatch in Sector 03. Connects Sector 03 directly to Sector 09!

rooms.name: Ventilation Bypass (SHORTCUT)
rooms.description: Wide pneumatic ventilation bypass. Opened by stacking 2 crates to clamber into the exhaust duct of Sector 06, leading straight into the Sector 13 Plasma Generator Hub!

rooms.name: Service Elevator Maintenance (SHORTCUT)
rooms.description: High-speed vertical express lift. Stack 2 crates in Sector 17 to bypass the blast shield, unlocking an instant elevator back to the Core Nexus Hub mezzanine!
